move: card track slides, inner images and blurred backdrop lag at different speeds
how: Four wide image cards (the fourth a copy of the first) sit on a horizontal track; behind them a blurred, saturated copy of each image fades in as its own backdrop. Three moves at 20%, 51% and 83% of the duration slide the track x by -760px per step with expo.inOut over 1.2s while every inner image (130% wide) tweens x in the opposite direction at 40% speed and the backdrop layer at 12%, so three planes move at three speeds; the matching backdrop crossfades opacity to 0.45 and the others to 0, and a call() updates the '01 / 03' counter and the pill dot halfway through each move. All cards breathe scale 1→1.02 and back with sine.inOut over the full duration. The dots are hidden on the last frame; no explicit exit because the fourth card equals the first.

port: mount(el, shot) builds the backdrops, track with N+1 cards and dots; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with moves at 0.2D, 0.51D and 0.83D via the move() helper written against el-scoped nodes. The counter/dot call()s should become el-scoped; the 8s breathe tween should be sized to D.
